rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for someone learning directly from a master, especially a practical skill or craft.

example.english: My disciple can already teach others on his own.
example.traditional: 我個徒弟已經識得自己教人喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 tou4 dai6 ji5 ging1 sik1 dak1 zi6 gei2 gaau3 jan4 laa3

rows.note: Use this formal or respectful term for a disciple of a teacher, school, or religious figure rather than an ordinary student.

example.english: Each disciple of Confucius was spread across different places.
example.jyutping: hung2 zi2 ge3 dai6 zi2 pin3 bou3 gok3 dei6

rows.note: Use this all-purpose term for an active follower of a person, movement, or philosophy.

example.english: That singer has a disciple who often promotes him online.
example.traditional: 呢個歌手有個追隨者成日喺網上幫佢宣傳。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 go1 sau2 jau5 go3 zeoi1 ceoi4 ze2 seng4 jat6 hai2 mong5 soeng6 bong1 keoi5 syun1 cyun4

rows.note: Choose this when the follower is a believer or adherent in a religious context.

example.english: This religious teacher has a disciple who comes to pray every day.
example.traditional: 呢位師父有個信徒日日嚟祈禱。
example.jyutping: ni1 wai2 si1 fu6 jau5 go3 seon3 tou4 jat6 jat6 lai4 kei4 tou2
